text: The account holder Usman Aslam holds account PK**UNIL****7198 which was opened on 25 November 2023. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. During the activity window from 3 July 2026 to 1 August 2026, there were 18 credits totalling PKR 28,850,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 21,636,000. The account received 17 cash deposits totalling PKR 28,630,000 at three branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 1 August 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, with 15 of 17 deposits between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 totalling PKR 27,270,000, are indicative of structuring. Deposits were spread across three branches, which is consistent with structuring indicators. The credits in the activity window were 131.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with declared income. The customer declined to explain the source of the cash when asked about the reporting requirement for deposits of PKR 2 million or more. Taken together, these patterns are consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 12,222,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 9,414,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank C) in 3 transactions. Debits equal to 75% of credits were paid out with a median time of 26.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. No match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening was found on 30 July 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
